title: tier-2 shipped code: map chunk GUID formula against MapChunkGuid (0x141b32e20)
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-tank/src/mapguid.rs, built by cargo and called by crates/ow-tank/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the chunk_guid entry. The ledger binds the verdict to mapguid.rs + the probe source + the git revision.
Oracle is MapChunkGuid at exe 0x141b32e20 (v2b 0x7ff7c6852e20). It returns u64 in RAX; arguments are uint map (ECX) and int slot (EDX); there is no output pointer and no loop.

The function reads the kind qword at +8 of the stride-0x20 table entry at exe 0x1439aa320 (v2b 0x7ff7c86ca320). Its 64-bit left shift by 32 discards the kind high 32 bits; the map argument is a uint, so only its low 32 bits are used. The shipped chunk_guid takes that kind and performs the same shift/OR.

The probe reads the same table slot from the pointee and calls ow_tank::mapguid::chunk_guid(map, kind). The state block places the fixture table at the table image address, so the oracle reads the fixture bytes; the pointer argument carries the identical bytes to the probe.

The table keeps the install kinds for the map loader 31 slots. Slots 0x1D, 0x1E, 0x21 and 0x22 (outside the loader set) carry the formula edges 0xFF, 0xFFFF, 0x1_0000 and 0xFFFF_FFFF; slot 0 already carries kind 0. The four required kind edges and the map edges 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1_0000_0000 and u64::MAX are pinned in the first eight cases.
The old shipped mask (kind & 0xFFFF) dropped kind 0x1_0000; the fn/ChunkGuid kind-0x1_0000 case is the first divergence that catches it.

The function has no conditional branches, so coverage is 100% by construction. The one mutation the line-oriented mutator can make is the map-mask widen (0xFFFFFFFF -> 0x1FFFFFFFF); map 0x1_0000_0000 kills it.
